/* the standard I/O of the linker's C library */
struct _iobuf {
	char	*_ptr;			/* the next character */
	int	_cnt;			/* how many are left (reading), or have room (writing) */
	char	*_base;			/* the buffer */
	char	_flag;
	char	_file;			/* the handle */
};
extern struct _iobuf _iob[];
#define FILE	struct _iobuf
#define BUFSIZ	512
#define _NFILE	6
#define _IOREAD	01
#define _IOWRT	02
#define _IONBF	04			/* no buffer: every character is written as it comes */
#define _IOEOF	020
#define _IOERR	040
#define EOF	(-1)
#define stdin	(&_iob[0])
#define stdout	(&_iob[1])
#define stderr	(&_iob[2])
#define putc(x, p) (--(p)->_cnt >= 0 ? (*(p)->_ptr++ = (x)) & 0377 : _flsbuf((x), p))
#define getc(p) (--(p)->_cnt >= 0 ? *(p)->_ptr++ & 0377 : _filbuf(p))
#define feof(p)		((p)->_flag & _IOEOF)
#define ferror(p)	((p)->_flag & _IOERR)
